guide.title: How to use Arth

screens.b: Open Arth every morning. The big card is the one job that matters most today, worked out from your weather, mandi prices and crop calendar.
how: Read the big green card first
Tap “Listen” to hear it aloud
Scroll down for weather, prices and district news

screens.b: On any screen, tap the green mic and speak in Marathi, Hindi or English.
how: Tap the mic and speak
Ask: “Should I spray today?”
Arth answers, and can open the right screen

screens.b: A photo of a sick leaf tells you the likely problem and what to do. The photo is never saved.
how: Tap Doctor at the bottom
Photograph one leaf up close, in daylight
Not sure? Call the Kisan Call Centre from the result

screens.b: Today's prices at mandis near you, and whether to sell now or wait.
how: Tap Mandi and pick your crop
Compare mandis after transport cost
Open “Sell Smart” and enter your quantity

screens.b: What to sow and when, for your district, your soil and this year’s monsoon.
how: Tap Calendar at the bottom
See where each of your crops stands today
Open a crop for its week-by-week plan

screens.b: Read a pesticide label, find government schemes or understand a paper, from the tools at the bottom of Home.
how: Label: the dose for your tank, only as printed
Schemes: a few yes/no questions
Kagaz: a photo of a paper, explained simply

screens.b: Change your language, farm details and alerts, or get help.
how: Tap Profile at the bottom
Settings has language, help and privacy
“Delete my data” is always there

guide.readyBody: Start each day on Home. Whenever you are unsure, the Kisan Call Centre is free.

faq.a: Yes. No payment and no ads.
